visible_observation: The abstract figure is currently anchored to the bottom edge of the canvas, with its base cut off by the frame. The title 'THE WEIGHT OF AIR' sits heavily on top, creating a static, vertical stack where the text and image compete for dominance rather than interacting.
critique: The composition lacks spatial tension and feels grounded rather than suspended. By anchoring the figure to the bottom, the design fails to visually represent the concept of 'Air' or 'Weightlessness.' The layout reads as a standard informational card (Title > Image > Details) rather than a unified, expressive composition. The figure feels like an illustration placed under a headline, rather than an integrated element of the poster's architecture.
revision: Translate the entire abstract figure group upward by approximately 15-20% to introduce negative space at the bottom. This will allow the figure to 'float' within the frame, creating a sense of suspension and allowing the visual weight to balance more dynamically against the heavy title block.
protected_strength: The sharp, geometric fragmentation of the figure and the high-contrast lighting effect are strong visual assets that must be preserved.
